exact_statement: For a Boolean f with v=Var(f)>0, freeze any admissible conditioned-forest representation and globally feasible positive lambda and finite distinct-run sets W_A covering its nonempty spectral support. Put c=Lambda+log2 Z, t_A=sum_(r in W_A)2^(-B_lambda(A;r)), R_*=v c+sum_(A nonempty)p_A(-log2 t_A), Kref=3+2log2 3+log2(6e), and U(A)=2^(-c-Kref|A|)t_A. Then U is a subprobability, min_P(E B-H(P))=-log2 t_A, and h2(v)+Kref I+R_*=H(f)+v D(P^+||U). Consequently universal R_*<=K I implies FEI with C=2+Kref+K. Independently, B<=K I implies good-coordinate B_i<=K alpha_i and FEI(K+2/ln2); full-signed L<=K I implies FEI(K+3/ln2), while FEI(C) implies B<=C I and L<=C I. No reverse admission into the forest reference family is asserted.
hypotheses: uniform finite Boolean cube

exact_statement: For every nonconstant finite Boolean indicator B=OR_l b_l with rho_l=E b_l>0, every r>=1 and every fixed lambda_l>0 with sum lambda_l<=1, let p=2^-r, F=2 A_r B-1 on fresh core coordinates, g=2B-1, v=Var(F), s=sum lambda_l rho_l, D=product(1+p lambda_l rho_l)-1 and delta=log2(D/(p s)). There exist distinct actual partition-forest laws with K=1 when the spectral set meets the core and 1<=K<=|T| otherwise. Their root block equals v log2(s)+v delta+r(E K-v) +E sum_roots log2(1/rho_l), with 0<=r(E K-v)<=p I(g)/2 and v delta<=(log2 e) 2rp E B. Thus normalized common-core rarity overhead is at most (log2 e) I(F), leaving base rarity and all remaining coding costs unpaid. For disjoint private conjunctions rho_l=2^-w_l and Q=product(1-rho_l), E K-v=4p^2 Q(sum rho_l-(1-Q)). All E are unconditioned spectral-weighted sums over nonempty sets; entropy units are bits. A fixed complete-reference scale prior lambda^(j)=2^-j lambda, w_j=1/((j+1)(j+2)) pays v for selecting j=0.

exact_statement: For any Boolean function class C containing constants and literals and closed under sign reversal, physical coordinate restrictions, disjoint Boolean products and point activation on fresh controls, for every Boolean f and integers t,r>=1, membership of f in C is equivalent to membership of g_t=z*product_{j=1}^t f(x^(j)) and equivalent to membership of 1+A_r(g_t-1). Furthermore, Let R consist of Boolean signs with finite globally read-once AND/OR/parity/negation formula certificates, literal or constant leaves and no opaque Boolean leaves. R is closed under restrictions, sign reversal, disjoint substitution, disjoint products, balancing and point activation on fresh controls. Every f in R satisfies corrected product-biased E(f)<=C0*(I(f)-Var(f)), C0=2+4/ln(2), and H(f)<=C0*I(f) for uniform original inputs. The balanced three-bit multiplexer M(x,y,z)=(1+x)y/2+(1-x)z/2 and all its activated balanced tensor powers are outside R. Overlapping OR substitution does not preserve R. For the control-first r-bit point activation of a fresh literal y, with p=2^(-r), the expected control depth D=2(1-p), I_sel=rp, I=p(r+1), and the uncompressed two-bits-per-query transcript has cost/I=4(2^r-1)/(r+1), tending to infinity. Every exact finite spectral witness W retaining its physical leaf label satisfies H(W|S)>=D-H(F)>=2(1-p)-4rp-2p*log2(e), whose displayed lower bound tends to two bits.

exact_statement: For every balanced finite uniform Boolean core g and every r>=1, put p=2^-r,F=1+A_r(g-1),v=p(2-p),Pplus=P_F conditioned on nonempty output. For every subprobability reference Q positive on the support of Pplus, let M=sum Q,q=Q/M,beta=1/(2-p),gamma=q(data spectral set nonempty),and q_g=q(data set | nonempty data). Then vD(Pplus||Q)=-v log2 M+vD_Ber(beta||gamma)+pD(P_g||q_g)+v(1-beta)D(Unif(nonempty control subsets)||q(control | empty data))+p sum_T P_g(T)D(Unif(all control subsets)||q(control | data T)). Consequently vD(Pplus||Q)>=pD(P_g||q_g). Infinite missing-support debt is interpreted in the extended sense. This localizes complete reference debt, without asserting cheap universal references or a lower bound by seed entropy.
